title: fix: correct VendorPrefix for ::-ms-input-placeholder pseudo-element
author: Bolt4243
summary: `::-ms-input-placeholder` is parsed as Placeholder(VendorPrefix::Moz) (copy-paste error), so it is rewritten to `::-moz-placeholder`, a different selector. One-token fix to VendorPrefix::Ms plus round-trip tests. The pseudo-class table already maps `:-ms-input-placeholder` to Ms, confirming intent. Doesn't add any old-browser hack; it just stops corrupting input.
evidence: Master: `input::-ms-input-placeholder{color:red}` -> `input::-moz-placeholder{color:red}`. src/selector.rs:291 still maps to Moz; line 169 (pseudo-class) uses Ms. #1352 touches the pseudo-class variants, not this line, so no conflict.
